transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Short one today. Lin, life test first.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Unit three is at roughly two thirds of the target cycles. No anomalies. I'll swap the lubricant on the next stop.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: dyno is free this aftrenoon if anyone needs it

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: *afternoon, after 1

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good. Andre, what's left on the thermal sweep?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: two more setpoints. the chiller tripped yesterday so i had to restart one, lost about an hr

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Quick thing before we go on, we need spacer set by 10/21, that's 12 of them, and it's holding up the fixture rebuild!!

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: yeah i know, i checked, no ship notice yet. i'll ping again

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: I reset the chiller. Low coolant, I topped it up. We should put a level check on the daily list!!

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Add it. Destiny, you got the second assembly done?

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Almost! Waiting on one snap ring that wouldn't seat 😬 I'll try the other pliers 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: If it's the same ring as last time, it's slightly oversize. Don't force it.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Got it, thanks Lin 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: sorry joining late whats the topic

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Nothing much, just the daily. Jade, anything on the dock?

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: two boxes came in this morning for carlos, one is from the bearing guys, im logging them now

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Perfect, I'll grab them after this.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: also the fixture drawings. i marked up rev b, will send nxt wk, no, tmrw, sorry

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: did anyone see the weird noise on the dyno gearbox last run, sounded like a tick

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Yes, I heard it. Log it. If it's still there Monday, we pull it apart.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK that's it, thanks all.
